messages:
Maya: Thinking out loud — we should add a compact provenance token to sampled request/response captures so support can correlate without storing PII. Idea: token encodes sampling_decision|route|bucket|fingerprint-hash, TTL, and a redact-confidence score.
Sanjay: Love the direction. question: how do we keep token reversible for ops while still preventing PII reconstruction?
Maya: Not reversible. token is a one-way HMAC over tenant_id + route + sample_id with a rotateable key. ops can lookup via a map that requires an auth check. no raw request data in DB.
Eli: Example token format? can we keep it short for URLs and console links?
Maya: Prototype: base62( hmac_v1 ) + meta suffix, e.g. 
```
prov:u7K3fQ-rt=chat-completion|s=1|c=0.87|ttl=3600
```
where s=sampled(1/0), c=redact_confidence.
Audrey: UX: console preview should show masked snippet + confidence bar, and a small "request provenance" badge that expands to the token and a link to request timeline (requires ops permissions).
Sanjay: Also need telemetry: track sampled_token_created, sampled_token_resolved, resolution_latency, and denied_resolution due to auth. want them on the routing & debug dashboards.
Maya: Agreed. We should also emit a compact telemetry blob with each sampled event: {prov_token, route, sample_reason, redact_conf}. nothing with user_id or prompt text.
infra-sre: Ops note — if we keep a lookup map (token -> full payload pointer) we need quota and TTL enforcement. need per-tenant quotas on how many tokens can be resolved per minute to avoid abuse.
Eli: What about canary/rollout? plan to flip on for internal tenants first, then select customers. We need console toggles: preview_off | preview_masked | preview_masked_confidence.
Audrey: For audits we also need a redaction confidence threshold that prevents even masked preview if confidence < 0.5. show a reason tooltip.
Maya: Implementation checklist: 1) sampling hook emits prov_token + telemetry 2) key rotation endpoint + audit log 3) console compact preview with confidence bar 4) admin resolution API with per-tenant QPS limit 5) dashboard tiles for token lifecycle.
Sanjay: API sketch for resolution (auth required):
```
POST /internal/v1/provenance/resolve
body: { token: "prov:u7K3fQ" }
response: { allowed: true, pointer: "s3://redact-blob/abc123", resolved_by: "ops@example.com" }
```
We should return only pointers and audit metadata, not the captured payload.
Maya: Test plan: smoke canary on staging, then 2-week internal beta with telemetry checks for 1) no PII in emitted events, 2) resolution latency < 200ms, 3) no auth bypass attempts.
ops-bot: deploy-check OK — staging flag `prov_token_preview` exists. canary group = redwood-internal + 3 partner tenants.
Audrey: Docs note: update privacy page with provenance token explanation and opt-out instructions for customers. legal signoff required.
Eli: One more edge: embeddings routes — avoid storing prompt/response pointers at all. only store minimal metadata and never pointer to raw embeddings if they contain customer data.
Maya: Good call. we'll special-case embeddings to only emit a hashed fingerprint and no pointer.
Sanjay: I'll draft the RFC with this flow and the telemetry metrics. ping me for design review.
Maya: Thanks — will put an initial PR with basic token gen + console stub tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Audrey: +1 from me, will book legal sync after RFC.
infra-sre: flagged for SRE review on quotas and key rotation runbook.
ops-bot: reminder: created ticket PLAT-4689 for implementation tracking.
Maya: Updated checklist in the ticket. stopping here for now.
